QuestInfo.name: [Mechanical Hearts 3] Scion's Lair
QuestInfo.0: Without warning, you were teleported to Scion's Lair with #bSpencer and Krania. Is Scion beyond your power to stop?
QuestInfo.2: #bScion#k wishes to take revenge on behalf of the Wondroids that suffered due to mistreatment by \n#bKrania#k and her company's policies. Its retribution, however, comes at too high a cost and must be stopped!
